messages:
jack-procurement: Heads-up — Orbital just pushed H100 allocation to 6–8 weeks (was 2–3). This will pinch our us-west-2 dedicated pool next week. Need options.

maria-ops: Oof. We have two canaries and a 24-unit reserve that hit low on Friday. If allocation slips, we'll run out of hot units by Tue.

ajay-sre: Can we shift some customer inference traffic to eu-west-1 temporarily? Network egress and tail latency will increase but buys time.

jack-procurement: Asked Orbital for split-shipment + expedite. They offered partial air for first 8 units at +18% per-unit, rest by sea. PO ref: PO-7890. Link: https://redwood.infra/procurement/PO-7890

selene-transport: Air queue adds customs broker lead (~48h) depending on AWB docs. If we do air, need return labels for depot RMA and photos.

maria-ops: Any available depot RMA pool we can fast-track? Even 4 units would help the canaries.

selene-transport: Depot just cleared 4 DOA H100s. Vendor will exchange if we provide serials, proof pics, and expedite courier. We can get +4 within 72h if we pay courier.

jack-procurement: Manifest snippet uploaded to vendor portal.

```
serials: [SN-H100-1234, SN-H100-1235, SN-H100-1236, SN-H100-1237]
AWB: 987654321US
carrier: SkyFreight
notes: temp-controlled, insurance requested
```

logistics-bot: [shipment logged] tracking: https://shipper.example/track/987654321US :truck:

chris-finance: Quick calc — full air for 24 units ~= +$38k. Partial air (4 depot RMA air, 8 immediate air, rest sea) ~= +$21k. Can charge to cost center 42.

ajay-sre: I'll throttle expensive jobs — reduce LLM-A per-route concurrency and drop `max_batch_tokens` to 512 for high-cost tenants. Saves ~15% token throughput.

maria-ops: Can we schedule a canary night window Fri 01:00 UTC to flip routing and measure perf?

jack-procurement: Vendor needs signed amendment by EOD to reserve the air allocation. Approve partial air + depot exchange? @chris-finance @cto

chris-finance: Approve partial air + RMA exchange. Please include manifest and allocate to center 42. :thumbsup:

selene-transport: I'll confirm courier pickup and book customs broker; will post AWB scan once uploaded. ETA to us-west-2 cluster ~72h after pickup.

jack-procurement: Thanks — amending PO now and will push docs. Will post final AWB + amendment here.

maria-ops: Once AWB is live, ping #eng-sre to trigger the routing changes. I'll stand by for canary Friday.

ajay-sre: Noted — prepping per-route fallback to `gpt-small` for latency-sensitive tenants and a rollout playbook.

jack-procurement: Closing for now — will update when courier confirms pickup and AWB scan is available.
